content: Ketsutsi meta 'ukaratsi tsamariyatanaka
Merikɨtsɨ Ti'aitame katiniutamarieni paritseutsixi memu'enanakɨ kename Ketsutsi yumɨireme teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete warayeitɨwakai meta wa'ɨyanekai, Wani yakɨ meyɨpaɨmeme xeikɨa wa'ɨyanekaku.
(Ketsutsi yɨkɨmana pɨkawaruka'ɨyakai, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama pɨta mepɨwaruka'ɨyakai).
Mɨpaɨ tiumarieka Kureya kanayeyani, hutarieka Karereya kaninuani.
Kaneuyewekaitɨni Tsamariya kwieyaritsie meutayunekɨ.
Hikɨ kiekaritsie kaninuani Tsamariya kwieyaritsie Tsikari mɨtiuyetewatsie, mana kanehurakaitɨni kwie Kakuwu yuniwe Kutse mɨyetuiritsie.
Putsu Kakuwu mɨwati'inixɨ mana kanitinierekaitɨni. Merikɨtsɨ Ketsutsi 'uxetɨ yeiyakɨ mana kanayerɨni putsu 'aurie tuka. Tuka 'ayeiximekaku.

Teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama kiekari hixɨapa mekane'uwakaitɨni 'ikwai meheunanaiyuka. Merikɨtsɨ 'ukaratsi mana kaninuani Tsamariya kiekame kuhanɨnetɨ, hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Etsiwa keneneuharitɨa.

Huriyutsixi tsamariyatari wahamatɨa 'aixɨa memɨkateyuxeiyakaikɨ. 'Ayumieme 'ukaratsi tsamariyatanaka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —¿Kehepaɨtɨtɨri 'ekɨ pehuriyutɨtɨ, neta 'ukaratsi nemɨtsamariyatanaka, haa pepɨnetsiwawirie?

Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Xɨka pe'imatenike tita Kakaɨyari mɨtiyumikwa, meta xɨka pe'imaikake kepaikɨ haa mɨmetsiwawirie, 'ekɨtsɨ pɨta pepɨnetsitawawirienikeyu, nepɨmatsiharitɨanikeyu haa muhanetsie mieme.
'Ukaratsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neuxei, hanɨweme pepɨkahexeiya, putsu 'apeukatewa, ¿hakewa pepeixeiya mɨkɨ haa tukari mɨtiyupitɨwa?
Tapaapa Kakuwu kanimariwekaitɨni 'ikɨ putsu mɨtatsi'umi, 'ena kanitiharewekaitɨni mɨkɨ meta niwemama meta tewamama. ¿'Ekɨ matsi kepetimariwe keyuri mɨkɨ?
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Yunaitɨ 'ikɨ haa memɨtihareni tawarita mepeuharikuni,
peru kemɨ'ane manuhareni ne ne'iharitɨayu tawariri hatsuaku pɨkaheuharimɨkɨni, matsi mɨkɨ haa nemiharitɨani, mɨkɨ haixa kanayeimɨkɨ hetsiena 'atineikatɨ tukari mɨkaxɨwe 'ipitɨatɨ.
'Ukaratsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ti'aitame, mɨkɨ haa keneneuharitɨa tawari nemɨkaheuharimɨkɨnikɨ, 'uwa paitɨ nemɨkahanɨnenikɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Merikɨte, 'akɨna kene'inimie, 'ena xekenakɨni.
'Ukaratsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Nepɨkarekakɨna. Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Herite, 'aixɨa pekanaineni nepɨkarekakɨna pemaine.
Yu'auxɨwime pepɨwarexeiyakai 'akɨnama. Mɨkɨ meta, hikɨ pemeixeiya, mɨkɨ pɨka'akɨna. 'Ayumieme yurikɨ peputaine.
'Ukaratsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ti'aitame, nekamenetimaniri 'ekɨ Kakaɨyari niukameya pekanihɨkɨtɨni.
Tame tatutsima 'ikɨ yemuritsie mekaniyutinenewiwakaitɨni. Peru xeme huriyutsixi xekaniutiyuaneni kename heuyewetse Kerutsareme temuyutinenewiwanikɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Neuxei 'ukaratsi, yuri kenetine'eririeka, tukari kanaye'amɨkɨ kepaukari nenewieri xemɨka'ipitɨaka yu'ukiyari 'ikɨ yemuritsie meta Kerutsareme.
Xeme nenewieri xepipitɨa kemɨ'ane xemɨkamate. Tame pɨta nenewieri tekanipitɨaka kemɨ'ane temɨmate, wikweitsitɨarika mayeneikakɨ huriyutsixi tahetsie.

Matsi tukari kanaye'amɨkɨ, hikɨ kanaye'aniri, kepauka mɨkɨ yurikɨ memɨyutinenewiwa nenewieri memipitɨani yu'ukiyari yu'iyarikɨ yuri me'utiyuatɨ. Mɨkɨ meta, ne'ukiyari mɨya me'aneneme kaniwakuwauneni nenewieri memipitɨanikɨ.
Kakaɨyari kani'iyaritɨni, kaneuyeweka mɨkɨ nenewieri memipitɨa yu'iyarikɨ memipitɨanikɨ yuri me'utiyuatɨ.
'Ukaratsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ne nekatinimaika kename 'uhamie Metsiyaxi, Kɨritsitu mɨtitewa. Kepauka mɨkɨ munuani, naime katatinitahekɨatɨamɨkɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Netsɨ nekanihɨkɨtɨni 'ahamatɨa nemɨtikuxata.
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mekaniu'axɨani, mekaniuhɨxiyani 'ukaratsi hamatɨa mɨtikuxatakaikɨ. Nixewitɨ mɨpaɨ pɨkatitahɨawixɨ: «¿Ketitakɨ petiku'iwawiya?» yatɨni «¿Ketitakɨ petikuxata hamatɨana?»
Hikɨ 'ukaratsi yuye'ɨ 'uku'eirieka kiekaritsie kaneyani, teɨteri mɨpaɨ katiniwaretahɨawe:
—Xekenakɨni xekenexeiyayu tewi mɨneretahekɨatɨa naime kenemɨtiuyuri. ¿Katikɨritsitu 'ikɨ?
Teɨteri kiekaritsie mekanayekɨne, hepana mekanahukaitɨni.
Merikɨtsɨ mexi 'ame'ahukai, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mekanita'inieni mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: —Ti'ɨkitame, ketineukwakari.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Ne 'ikwai nekanexeiyani xemɨka'imate xeme.
'Ayumieme mɨpaɨ mekateniyɨkɨhɨawekaitɨni teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete: «Xewitɨ kati'atɨiri katiukwairi».
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Kenemɨtikamie tita mɨtinake 'iya mɨnetsiheyenɨ'a, 'uximayatsikaya kenemɨtinɨxime, mɨkɨ kanine'ikwaitɨni.
¿Xeme mɨpaɨ xekate'utiyuane: “Nauka metseri tixɨyu 'itsanaxa kanaye'amɨkɨ”? Kamɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨtixekɨhɨawe: Xekeneutanierixɨa, waxa xekeneuxeiya. Kaniwawakiniri xemɨka'itsanakɨ.
Hikɨ 'itsaname katini'iwaneniri, kanikuxeɨrieni tita mɨtiutixuawerixɨ, tukari mɨkaxɨwe memexeiyanikɨ, 'etsame 'itsaname hamatɨa yaxeikɨa memɨyutemamawiekakɨ.
'Ikɨ hepaɨtsita niuki yuri paine: “Xewitɨ kani'etsametɨni, xewitɨta ti'itsaname”.
Ne nepɨxeheutanɨ'axɨa xemɨka'itsanakɨ xemɨkateha'uximayakaitsie. Hipatɨ mekateni'uximayakaitɨni. Wa'uximayatsika xehetsie katiniunake.
Merikɨtsɨ yumɨiretɨ mana kiekatari Tsamariyatari yuri mekateniuta'erieni hetsiena 'ukaratsi tiutahekɨataku yuniukikɨ mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Naime kenemɨtiuyuri kanetiniutahekɨatɨani».
'Ayumieme Tsamariyatari hetsɨana me'u'axɨaka mekanita'inieni wahetsɨa muyuhayewakɨ. Mana huta tukari kaniyuhayewa.
Hipatɨta yumɨiretɨ yuri mekateniuta'erieni niukieyakɨ.
Mɨpaɨ 'ukaratsi mekateniutahɨawe: —Hikɨrixɨa 'aniukikɨ xeikɨa yuri tepɨkate'erie, tameri tekani'enieni, tekatenimaika 'ikɨ yurikɨ kwiepa memɨtama wawikweitsitɨwame mɨhɨkɨkɨ.
Ketsutsi kemɨrenayehɨa ti'aitame parewiwameya nu'aya
Merikɨtsɨ huta tukari 'anukayaku mana kaniyeyani, Karereya kaninuani.
(Ketsutsi yɨkɨmana katiniutahekɨata kename nixewitɨ Kakaɨyari niukameya yukwiepa 'aixɨa katixeiyarie).
Peru kepauka Karereya munua Karereyatari mekanitanaki'erieni naime mete'uxeiyaka kemɨreyurienekai Kerutsareme 'ixɨararipa. Mɨkɨta memeku'ixɨarakaikɨ.

Merikɨtsɨ hutarieka Kanahatsie kaninuani Karereya kwieyaritsie haa kaxie winuyari mayeitɨatsie. Xewitɨ kwiepa ti'aitame mɨparewiwameyatɨkai mana kaniuyeikakaitɨni, nu'aya katinekuyekaitɨni Kaperunaumetsie.
Tiutamarieka kename Ketsutsi Kureya heyeyaka Karereya nuakai, hetsɨana kaneyani, kanitawawirieni meukayanikɨ nu'aya 'aixɨa reu'eriekame mayeitɨanikɨ. Mɨkɨ kanemɨximekaitɨni.
Ketsutsi 'ayumieme mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Xɨka 'inɨarite xeka'uxeiya, mamariwaweme, yuri xepɨkateta'erieni.
Mɨkɨ ti'aitame parewiwameya mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ti'aitame, mana keneukayuni neniwe mexi 'akuxi kahemɨwe.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kenemie, 'aniwe kanayeniereniri. Hikɨ mɨkɨ tewi yuri katiniuta'erieni niukieyatsie Ketsutsi kemɨtitahɨawixɨ. Kaneyani.
Mana heukamiekaku te'uximayatametemama mekanenukunake mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe kename nu'aya 'ayenierekairi.
Mɨkɨ kaniuta'iwauni ya'utaitɨ ke'upaukakaku 'aixɨa reu'erietɨ matɨa. Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Takai tau 'etsiwa kɨa heuwiekaku kahɨiyatɨ kanayani.
Hikɨ paapaya katinetimani 'ana mɨya'upaukakaku Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ mɨreitahɨawixɨ: «'Aniwe kanayeniereniri». Hikɨ mɨkɨ yuri katiniuta'erieni, meta yunaitɨ kiena kiekatari.
'Ipaɨ hutarieka 'inɨari katiniuwewieni Ketsutsi Kureya heyeyaka Karereya nuaka.
